exact: down regulation of mitotic metaphase/anaphase transition

definition: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the cell cycle process in which a cell progresses from metaphase to anaphase during mitosis, triggered by the activation of the anaphase promoting complex by Cdc20/Sleepy homolog which results in the degradation of Securin.
label: negative regulation of mitotic metaphase/anaphase transition
